paper_metadata.title: High temperature properties and fatigue strength of novel wrought γ/γ′ Co-base superalloys

evidence.quote: This paper presents the high temperature yield and fatigue strength as well as thermophysical properties of two polycrystalline wrought c/c9 Co-base superalloys developed for application in a temperature regime above 700 °C.
